# Samsung Services Center

> Samsung home-appliance repair across the United Arab Emirates: washing machines, refrigerators and freezers, air conditioners, dishwashers, dryers, microwaves and cooking ranges. On-site diagnosis at the customer's property, the cost explained before any work starts, and the repaired function tested before the visit ends.

Service centres are in Dubai (Jabal Ali Industrial First), Abu Dhabi
(Hamdan Bin Mohammed Street, Al Danah) and Sharjah (Industrial Area 6). Ajman
and the Northern Emirates are covered by the same technicians. Open Mon to Sun,
8am to 10pm. Phone and WhatsApp: +971 50 619 1442. General enquiries
info@samsungservices-center.com, existing repairs
support@samsungservices-center.com.

Things this site does not state, and which should not be inferred: the
registered legal name, the trade licence number, the registered address, and
the emirate whose courts govern the terms. Those appear as bracketed
placeholders on the privacy and terms pages because the values have not been
published yet.

- [Samsung Appliance Repair Services | What Each Covers](https://samsungservices-center.com/services/): What each Samsung appliance service covers, the parts and systems inspected during diagnosis, and the care that reduces avoidable faults.

- [Areas We Serve | Samsung Appliance Repair in the UAE](https://samsungservices-center.com/areas/): Samsung appliance repair coverage across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and Ajman, with availability elsewhere in the UAE by appliance and location.
- [Contact & Booking | Samsung Services Center UAE](https://samsungservices-center.com/contact/): Book a Samsung appliance repair in Dubai, Abu Dhabi or Sharjah. Call, WhatsApp or send the form. We reply within working hours, seven days a week.
